「If something like that exists,
　shouldn't we get it before Neo Zeon does?」

stage0069_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's not much point in us, who
　nominally belong to the Earth Federation,
　getting our hands on power to overthrow it」

stage0069_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Besides, we don't have the luxury right now
　to be chasing after such an uncertain legend」

stage0069_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$シン$$
「Above all, the only one who can activate the
　NT-D synced to the Laplace Program is $$バナージ$$」

stage0069_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$シン$$
「And that $$バナージ$$ refuses to get involved
　with Laplace's Box, the source of it all」

stage0069_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$タケル$$
「Besides, today's Earth Federation isn't the same
　as $$ＵＣＷ$$'s. I doubt Laplace's Box would work here」

stage0069_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Let's focus on the talks with Neo Zeon for now.
　This might just be what ends the fighting
　between Earth and the colonies」

stage0069_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$マオ$$
「...Sounds like it was rough everywhere.」

stage0069_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$葵$$
「That goes for $$ミスリル$$ too, doesn't it?」

stage0069_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$マオ$$
「Well, yeah.
　From $$ヘルマジスタン$$ to Hong Kong,
　it's been nonstop fighting with Amalgam and $$マーティアル$$」

stage0069_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$朔哉$$
「We heard the news too, about the raid
　on $$マーティアル$$'s holy site, $$アレギウム$$.」

stage0069_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「With the war god's holy site invaded,
　$$マーティアル$$'s authority will collapse at once.」

stage0069_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$カレン$$
「...But... we lost someone precious to us...」

stage0069_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$キリコ$$
「$$フィアナ$$'s time simply ran out.
　It's no one's fault」

stage0069_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「...Even without words, his sorrow comes through.」

stage0069_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「$$キリコ$$ keeps fighting without saying a word.」

stage0069_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$マリー$$
「That's why we don't bring it up either」

stage0069_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Sounds like $$アレルヤ$$ and $$マリー$$'s journey took a break.」

stage0069_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$マリー$$
「It's been a while, $$いぶき$$.
　I'm glad to work with everyone at
　$$２１世紀警備保障$$ again.」

stage0069_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Likewise.
　Good to have you around again, $$マリー$$.」

stage0069_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「We're not the only ones who joined up.
　$$ティエリア$$ did too.」

stage0069_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「And $$張五飛$$ has resolved to fight alongside us too」

stage0069_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$五飛$$
「That's right.
　I'll be in your debt again」

stage0069_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$青山$$
「Hey... isn't that a bit too self-serving?」

stage0069_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$赤木$$
「Come on, $$青山$$.
　Looks like $$ヒイロ$$ and the others accepted $$五飛$$ too.」

stage0069_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Besides, he seems gentler than he used to be.」

stage0069_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$赤木$$
「Guess $$五飛$$'s grown from all he's been through.」

stage0069_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$五飛$$
「That's the plan.
　I won't waver again.」

stage0069_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Strong words.
　A man who truly deserves to be called a warrior」

stage0069_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Lieutenant $$ベルファンガン・クルーゾー$$, dispatched
　from $$ミスリル$$'s Mediterranean Fleet.
　I inherited the $$ウルズ$$ 1 code from Captain $$マッカラン$$」

stage0069_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$赤木$$
「So he's the superior officer of $$宗介$$ and the others...」

stage0069_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$タケル$$
「Sounds like $$宗介$$'s been through a lot too.」

stage0069_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Of course.
　Though the silent type hasn't changed much.」

stage0069_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「But Sagara's gotten stronger.
　At the very least, he's starting to
　handle that Lambda Driver of his」

stage0069_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$クルツ$$
「And get this, surprisingly enough,
　he's gotten friendly with that jerk $$アル$$ too」

stage0069_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$葵$$
「$$アル$$, as in the Arbalest's control AI?」

stage0069_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$宗介$$
「I can't put it well, but it's no ordinary AI」

stage0069_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Boss $$マオ$$'s M9 and mine got tuned up too.
　Our combat power's gone up」

stage0069_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$甲児$$
「After this, it's up to how Neo Zeon plays it...」

stage0069_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$タケル$$
「Yeah.
　This is probably going to be
　a major turning point for the world...」

stage0069_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「...No way!
　That $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ bastard's got insane power!」

stage0069_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「He can not only control black holes freely,
　but use that power to summon space monsters
　and $$インベーダー#keyword$$s from deep space to Earth.」

stage0069_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$カレン$$
「How are we even supposed to fight something like that...」

stage0069_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$タケル$$
「We almost got swallowed by a black hole ourselves」

stage0069_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$宗介$$
「How did you get out of that situation?」

stage0069_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$グーラ$$... that selfish prince, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son, right...」

stage0069_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's right.
　$$グーラ$$ was ordered to command Earth's conquest, but...」

stage0069_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「He said he wanted to take Earth by his own strength,
　and turned down the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s help」

stage0069_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Guess that's a rich boy's pride, huh.」

stage0069_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Deep down, I don't think $$グーラ$$ really
　wants to fight」

stage0069_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$竜馬$$
「The fight against the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ isn't over, but
　we've wrapped things up with the Mechanical Beast Army」

stage0069_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$隼人$$
「Mind you, we took down $$ブロッケン$$, but
　we let the army's boss, $$あしゅら男爵$$, get away」

stage0069_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$マオ$$
「Can you really call that settled?」

stage0069_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$竜馬$$
「We took down most of the Mechanical Beasts he had.
　Even if $$あしゅら$$'s got forces left,
　it can't be much」

stage0069_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$甲児$$
（I get that much myself...
　but what... is this uneasy feeling...）

stage0069_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do you have something on your mind, $$甲児$$?」

stage0069_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$甲児$$
（Yeah... it's probably just my imagination...）

stage0069_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$シモン$$ finally proposed to $$ニア$$」

stage0069_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Pulling that off these days, you charmer!」

stage0069_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Guess I can't let myself lose then.」

stage0069_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$キタン$$
「You bet!
　No matter who we're up against, we've gotta win!」

stage0069_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Not that, $$キタン$$.
　I mean where your own crush is headed.）

stage0069_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$クルツ$$
（$$ヨーコ$$'s bound to feel something too,
　seeing a friend her age get engaged.
　This could be your chance.）

stage0069_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$キタン$$'s right.
　We've got to turn this momentum into a chance.」

stage0069_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$キタン$$
（$$クルツ$$...
　Is this really... my chance?）

stage0069_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Sorry...
　I'm losing my confidence in that too...）

stage0069_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah...
　For the sake of the people waiting for us,
　we have to save the world, no matter what」

stage0069_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$赤木$$
「Trider, $$鉄人$$, $$オックス$$...
　and $$ダイ・ガード$$ has powered up too.
　We'll do this with that strength」

stage0069_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$デュオ$$
「...Sounds like things are lively over there,
　but how'd it go for the space squad?」

stage0069_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$ was taken by an Abductor...」

stage0069_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$イズモ$$, Altair's supreme commander...
　He came at us himself」

stage0069_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That's not right, $$ゼシカ$$.
　$$ＭＩＸ$$ getting taken is on all of us」

stage0069_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So we... I absolutely have to
　rescue $$ＭＩＸ$$」

stage0069_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Aquarion's gotten stronger too.
　We'll pull it off」

stage0069_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$ノイン$$
（Looks like the real problem is $$ゼシカ$$...）

stage0069_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ゼクス$$
（She seems to be carrying quite a bit of mental stress.）

stage0069_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
（From what $$サザンカ$$ told me,
　the cause was getting turned down by $$アマタ$$.）

stage0069_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ノイン$$
（This isn't really anyone's fault...
　$$ゼシカ$$ just has to pull herself out of it...）

stage0069_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$カミーユ$$...
　What do you make of Neo Zeon's movements?」

stage0069_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Honestly, I don't know.
　...Though $$シャア・アズナブル$$ says he too
　is fighting for the sake of the world」

stage0069_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Neo Zeon seized the resource satellite Fifth Luna
　and tried to drop it on Earth.」

stage0069_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$マリー$$
「If they did that, Earth would...」

stage0069_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The damage would've been beyond imagining.」

stage0069_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$キラ$$
「Apparently $$シャア・アズナブル$$ tried to
　break open the Prison of Time using
　the shock from Fifth Luna's fall」

stage0069_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Hard to believe right away.
　That he'd try something like that...」

stage0069_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I... don't think $$シャア$$ was the one
　who came up with that plan...」

stage0069_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$.
　...Just my gut feeling, though.」

stage0069_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$刹那$$
「The masked man who was $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s body double...
　Another Red Comet, is he.」

stage0069_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「According to reports, even within Neo Zeon,
　that man's been acting on his own...」

stage0069_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We've learned part of the secret
　behind the Unicorn that $$フル・フロンタル$$ wanted.」

stage0069_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$キラ$$
「The Laplace Program...
　seems like that's what he's after.」

stage0069_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「What is this Laplace Program?」

stage0069_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ＵＣＷ$$... no, in the world we're from,
　called the $$宇宙世紀$$, there's something
　called 'Laplace's Box', apparently.」

stage0069_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We don't really know what it actually is.
　But it apparently holds the power
　to overthrow the Earth Federation.」

stage0069_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Some kind of super-weapon, or technology?」

stage0069_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We don't know that either.
　Even its credibility is unclear.」

stage0069_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But in reality, we suspect $$フル・フロンタル$$
　has been moving to seize that Laplace's Box.」

stage0069_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$刹那$$
「Does obtaining the Unicorn mean
　obtaining Laplace's Box itself?」

stage0069_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「But hey, I heard that Gundam got
　captured by Neo Zeon before, didn't it?」

stage0069_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「If they wanted that Laplace's Box,
　wouldn't they have already gotten it then?」

stage0069_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Unicorn's apparently the key to the Box.」

stage0069_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「When the Unicorn triggers the NT-D
　at specific coordinates, it reveals data on the Box.」

stage0069_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If such a thing exists,
　shouldn't we get it before Neo Zeon does?」

stage0069_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We nominally belong to the Earth Federation,
　so it wouldn't mean much for us
　to seize the power to overthrow it.」

stage0069_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Besides, we don't have the luxury right now
　to be chasing after some uncertain legend.」

stage0069_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$シン$$
「Besides, only $$バナージ$$ can trigger
　the NT-D synced to the Laplace Program.」

stage0069_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$シン$$
「And that $$バナージ$$ refuses to get involved
　with Laplace's Box, the cause of this fight.」

stage0069_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Besides, today's Earth Federation is different
　from $$ＵＣＷ$$'s. I doubt Laplace's Box would work here.」

stage0069_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Let's focus on the talks with Neo Zeon now.
　This might just be what ends the war
　between Earth and the colonies, after all.」

stage0069_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$n
「...Sorry.
　Before the talks with Neo Zeon, I want to
　sort out my own thoughts a little...」

stage0069_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$n
「I don't really know much about the person
　called $$シャア・アズナブル$$... Captain $$クワトロ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$n
「But I'm sure that once this meeting
　sets the world moving, they'll show up.」

stage0069_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$n
「Before I settle things with them...
　with $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, I want to steel myself.」

stage0069_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Understood.
　Then I'll say goodbye to everyone for you.」

stage0069_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$n
「Sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　Please give everyone my regards.」

stage0069_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Yeah...
　unlike before, he's not walling himself off）

stage0069_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$ヒル$$
「We'll reach the meeting point shortly.」

stage0069_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$レウルーラ$$ stays on standby here.
　I'll go to $c by mobile suit.」

stage0069_03:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Do you intend to willingly fall into enemy hands?」

stage0069_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$シャア$$
「They won't resort to cheap tricks.
　That much I can guarantee.」

stage0069_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But if something were to happen...」

stage0069_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$シャア$$
「If they did that, the war between Earth
　and the colonies would only become
　a quagmire. They understand that too.」

stage0069_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$シャア$$
「Assassination always sparks new conflict...
　It did with Zeon Zum Deikun,
　and with $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$ヒイロ・ユイ$$...」

stage0069_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Are you saying assassination is a poor tactic?」

stage0069_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$シャア$$
「...But even so, they happened anyway.
　As if some force was at work there...」

stage0069_03:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I can't leave this to you alone.
　I'm coming to the $$ラー・カイラム$$ too.」

stage0069_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$シャア$$
「You don't seem convinced about this meeting...」

stage0069_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Of course not.
　Supreme Commander or not, this is your call alone.」

stage0069_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$シャア$$
「...There was a reason I had to do it this way...」

stage0069_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'm taking $$ギュネイ$$ and $$クェス$$ along as escorts.
　I'll head to the hangar ahead of you.」

stage0069_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That $$シャア$$...
　Just what is he thinking...」

stage0069_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Supreme Commander may have forgotten
　the Spacenoids' cries of resentment.」

stage0069_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's practically denying Zeon's very way of being.」

stage0069_03:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm not the Supreme Commander,
　so I can't fully know what's in his heart.」

stage0069_03:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「What a roundabout way of putting it.
　Are you trying to provoke me?」

stage0069_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Know your place, $$フル・フロンタル$$.
　Did you think I wouldn't notice
　you skulking around behind my back?」

stage0069_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「What is it you want?
　To take $$シャア$$'s place?」

stage0069_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Please don't misunderstand me.
　I'm a man who wears this mask for Neo Zeon's sake.」

stage0069_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I understand this body of mine to be a vessel
　that gathers the wishes of the Spacenoids.」

stage0069_03:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Very well.
　I'll hear the rest after the talks.」

stage0069_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（Such a woman, $$ハマーン$$...）

stage0069_03:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（Now then... how will things move...?
　My own actions depend on where this leads...）

stage0069_03:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（For the sake of this world's rightful way of being）

stage0069_03:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Should I say welcome,
　Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$?」

stage0069_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$シャア$$
「So you're serving as moderator, $$ロジャー$$?」

stage0069_03:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm quite used to this kind of role,
　even from the 《$$コペルニクス会談$$》.」

stage0069_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$ブライト$$
「No need for pointless pleasantries now.」

stage0069_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$シャア$$
「Indeed.
　This meeting is an unofficial one.
　There's no need for surface pleasantries.」

stage0069_03:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right, $$アムロ$$.
　Let's set personal feelings aside, and first
　act for the sake of this world, together.」

stage0069_03:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　...Though when it comes to means, I do feel
　there's a gulf between you and me.」

stage0069_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「That gulf is something we could never accept.
　That's why we've fought against Neo Zeon...
　no, against you.」

stage0069_03:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$シャア$$
「...So you've taken off the mask.」

stage0069_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「If we're to face each other like this,
　I want to look you in the eye too, directly.」

stage0069_03:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$シャア$$
「I can see the depth of your resolve, $$ゼロ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I'll say it again, $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　We have no intention of accepting your way.」

stage0069_03:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's exactly what personal feeling is.
　This is a war of the Federation against every Spacenoid.」

stage0069_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you're going to oppose us as well,
　then come bearing Earth's people on your back.」

stage0069_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'm sorry, $$ハマーン$$.
　We can't do that.」

stage0069_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We intend to carry the future of all humanity.
　...Though perhaps that's a bit too bold a claim.」

stage0069_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Naturally, that includes the colony residents too.」

stage0069_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Spare me the sophistry.
　You'd overlook the rise of Earth supremacists
　and still claim only you are pure?」

stage0069_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「As for Chrono's movements, we're investigating too.
　We won't leave those in the Federation's shadows unchecked.」

stage0069_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Is smoking them out
　the purpose of your war?」

stage0069_03:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$シャア$$
「Even without Geminis's scheme,
　they'd have eventually carried out
　brutal suppression against the Spacenoids.」

stage0069_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Are you saying the war was inevitable?」

stage0069_03:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Do you think you're controlling this war, $$シャア$$?」

stage0069_03:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$シャア$$
「I leave that judgment to you.」

stage0069_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let's end this war of words as our greeting.
　Those watching this meeting grow uneasy too.」

stage0069_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「As Supreme Commander $$シャア$$ wished,
　everyone in $c is watching
　this meeting over the monitors.」

stage0069_03:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then I can't afford to let my guard down.
　Not if I don't want to disappoint $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Bold of you, bringing up $$カミーユ$$'s name so freely.
　Was it you who had Lieutenant $$アポリー$$ deliver the Zeta?」

stage0069_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Fine.
　Then tell me first, why you wanted this meeting.」

stage0069_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$シャア$$
「As I said before.
　It's to protect this world.」

stage0069_03:r_6d287e4652a3781f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「And yet you have no intention of stopping the war.」

stage0069_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$シャア$$
「I don't intend to yield to either
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ or $$バアル$$.
　In other words, the world goes on...」

stage0069_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$シャア$$
「And for the sake of what comes after,
　I simply believe this planet Earth...
　this world, needs to be changed.」

stage0069_03:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Lofty ambitions.
　So in reality, how do you plan to deal
　with those two problems looming before us?」

stage0069_03:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'll have her explain that.
　...She should be arriving soon.」

stage0069_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Excuse me.
　I've brought $$ナナイ・ミゲル$$
　and Dr. $$トライア・スコート$$ with me.」

stage0069_03:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「No...
　I'll take my leave now.」

stage0069_03:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（Lingering attachment...
　How unmanly, $$シャア$$）

stage0069_03:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$シャア$$
「...You did well too, $$ナナイ$$.
　Getting the doctor off Earth must've been a chore.」

stage0069_03:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「No... it was nothing like that...」

stage0069_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$トライア$$
「Don't talk like I'm some recluse.
　I'm not so jaded I'd miss a front-row seat
　to a turning point in history.」

stage0069_03:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still keeping busy as ever, I see.」

stage0069_03:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$トライア$$
「Well, yeah.
　Now that the fog in my head's cleared up,
　the research is coming along nicely too.」

stage0069_03:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Then a way to break the Prison of Time, too...」

stage0069_03:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$トライア$$
「That's the very reason
　Supreme Commander $$シャア$$ called me here.」

stage0069_03:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Just what I'd expect from Dr. $$トライア$$.」

stage0069_03:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So this is how the world gets saved...」

stage0069_03:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$トライア$$
「Don't jump to conclusions.
　...And before I get to that, there's
　something I need to confirm with you all.」

stage0069_03:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$ブライト$$
「And what would that be?」

stage0069_03:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$トライア$$
「Whether you've forgotten that $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　and $$バアル$$ are mutually exclusive.」

stage0069_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$トライア$$
「From the look on your faces, seems you get it.」

stage0069_03:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$トライア$$
「Once the dimensional boundary is fully fixed,
　time for every living thing here drops to zero,
　and humanity slowly walks the road to ruin...」

stage0069_03:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So that's $$エタニティ・フラット$$...」

stage0069_03:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$トライア$$
「$$バアル$$, meanwhile, is humanity's natural foe,
　incarnate destruction that either can't be
　talked to, or isn't worth the attempt.」

stage0069_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$トライア$$
「Right now, space monsters and $$インベーダー#keyword$$ are confirmed,
　but going by the data left in the $$ガンバスター$$
　and Dr. Saotome's research...」

stage0069_03:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$トライア$$
「It's been confirmed they come invading
　from the galactic core.」

stage0069_03:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$トライア$$
「Now, they use hyperspace navigation to reach Earth,
　but once the boundary around Earth locks down
　for good, they won't be able to jump so easily.」

stage0069_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「In other words, completing $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　becomes a breakwater against $$バアル$$'s invasion.」

stage0069_03:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Wait for a slow self-destruction,
　or meet ruin at an outside enemy's hands...
　That's far too hopeless a choice.」

stage0069_03:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$トライア$$
「So, what'll it be?
　Which of the two will you choose?」

stage0069_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not for us to decide that.
　It's for all of humanity.」

stage0069_03:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「For a handful of people to decide the world's fate
　is nothing but arrogance.」

stage0069_03:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$トライア$$
「Can I take that as everyone's consensus?」

stage0069_03:r_02c89111c680d125.text:
$$トライア$$
「Then all I can do for now
　is teach you how to break the Prison of Time.
　We'll figure out what comes after, later.」

stage0069_03:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$トライア$$
「All together.
　...Isn't that right, Commander?」

stage0069_03:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$トライア$$
「Now then, about that method...」

stage0069_03:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You've completed a way to artificially
　trigger a $$時空震動$$?」

stage0069_03:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$トライア$$
「The theory's done, but there's no way to do it...」

stage0069_03:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$トライア$$
「Triggering a $$時空震動$$ takes a huge $$次元力$$.」

stage0069_03:r_5777cb06f7e0103f.text:
$$トライア$$
「In terms you'd understand, it's something like
　$$ランド$$ or Setsuko... or Crowe's $$スフィア$$
　running past 300% output.」

stage0069_03:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$トライア$$
「I even checked with Mars's 《$$マルグリット$$》.
　《$$インサラウム$$》's dimensional science is
　somewhat ahead of ours, after all.」

stage0069_03:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「...I don't even need to ask how that went.」

stage0069_03:r_e81e034b71411af7.text:
$$トライア$$
「Unfortunately, yeah.
　Without 《$$ＺＯＮＥ$$》, $$インサラウム$$ can't manage
　even a dimensional tremor, let alone a $$時空震動$$.」

stage0069_03:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「With 《$$アンブローン・ジウス$$》 gone now,
　$$インサラウム$$'s forbidden art... dimensional science
　is a lost technology too, then...」

stage0069_03:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So a $$時空震動$$ needs
　that much energy...」

stage0069_03:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「And the bickering twins, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$,
　actually pull that off...」

stage0069_03:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$トライア$$
「That smirking drunk's level with a $$スフィア$$
　is a cut above Crowe and the others.」

stage0069_03:r_718d4f86b37b2915.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Without triggering a $$時空震動$$,
　how do you mean to break the Prison of Time?」

stage0069_03:r_2cd57aac659672dc.text:
$$トライア$$
「We're not breaking it open.
　We're repairing it to its original state.」

stage0069_03:r_984737d2920b03f7.text:
$$トライア$$
「Right... $$時空修復$$.
　...Are you OK? Mr. Singularity?」

stage0069_03:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
$$桂$$
「...I see.
　So that's why someone as out of place
　as me got called to this table.」

stage0069_03:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
$$桂$$
「Though I'm the singularity of 《$$大時空震動$$》,
　I'm not the singularity of the $$新世時空震動$$
　that started the Prison of Time.」

stage0069_03:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So $$桂$$ can't repair the current
　state of spacetime on his own...」

stage0069_03:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$トライア$$
「Still, it makes a model case.
　In $$ＵＣＷ$$, didn't $$桂$$ and another singularity
　touch the Great Singularity and stop a collapse?」

stage0069_03:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So if we track down the $$新世時空震動$$'s singularity,
　we can repair the boundary and erase the Prison of Time.」

stage0069_03:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$ブライト$$
「A singularity...
　The thing, place, or person that touched off a $$時空震動$$...」

stage0069_03:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$トライア$$
「In other words, a turning point in spacetime.
　Something that changes the world or history
　from there... that's a $$時空震動$$'s singularity.」

stage0069_03:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$シャア$$
「Now that you've heard this much,
　you understand why I reached out to you.」

stage0069_03:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　Operating within the atmosphere is difficult for us.」

stage0069_03:r_1ce9868e47e05f97.text:
$$シャア$$
「Which is why we of Neo Zeon
　want to sign a truce with $c.」

stage0069_03:r_cb789b091a7a05ca.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Have you considered telling the truth to the
　Earth Federation, and stopping the war itself?」

stage0069_03:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$シャア$$
「Not while Geminis, who made the Prison of Time,
　has Chrono... the Earth Federation's dark side,
　helping it along.」

stage0069_03:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Unfortunately, that's a fair point.」

stage0069_03:r_1efac5b6d8fb1238.text:
$$シャア$$
「I distrust the Earth Federation as an entity...
　But you are different.」

stage0069_03:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Because we once fought together as comrades?」

stage0069_03:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$$シャア$$
「I can't explain it in words.
　...Call it the same thing you feel toward me.」

stage0069_03:r_99128140e453d460.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Are you saying that deep down, we trust you?」

stage0069_03:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...$$アムロ$$, I want to hear your opinion.」

stage0069_03:r_722be3d36da4979c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Not that I want to admit it.」

stage0069_03:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Let me say this, $$シャア$$.
　That doesn't mean I approve of your methods.」

stage0069_03:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But I don't want to believe you're the kind
　of man who'd watch humanity die for his own ego.」

stage0069_03:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$シャア$$
「Nor do I intend to live in a way
　that would earn your contempt.」

stage0069_03:r_c01f3d97d765f442.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（So in the end, it's $$アムロ・レイ$$...）

stage0069_03:r_f2a506c32c68b595.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「With that, our will is decided.」

stage0069_03:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So, $c will call a truce with Neo Zeon,
　and focus on searching for the singularity
　in the atmosphere... Does that work for you?」

stage0069_03:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Somewhat against my better judgment, but yes.」

stage0069_03:r_53dd6bae12e095c3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Can't say I've got no objection,
　but needs must.」

stage0069_03:r_bccb0c4cb58aa146.text:
$$ブライト$$
「This is our answer, $$シャア$$.」

stage0069_03:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$$トライア$$
「OK.
　I'll put together the data on the singularity's
　physical traits on my end.」

stage0069_03:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$トライア$$
「Use that as a reference and get the search going.」

stage0069_03:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$桂$$
「But be careful.
　In my experience, a singularity's existence
　just breeds needless conflict.」

stage0069_03:r_83e0e74db0ae4d4f.text:
$$桂$$
「If that existence goes public,
　Geminis and everyone helping them
　won't just sit quiet either.」

stage0069_03:r_d85829b2f9bff450.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood.
　Even after we find it, we'll need to keep this quiet.」

stage0069_03:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$シャア$$
「...Now that the talks have settled down,
　there's one favor I'd ask.」

stage0069_03:r_518305c95e4d1da4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'll say this first,
　we only agreed to a truce over the singularity search.
　We won't take part in your war.」

stage0069_03:r_78ebe98c49194738.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it.
　...I want to borrow a certain machine.」

stage0069_03:r_5cf3d385c6d4b8d0.text:
$$シャア$$
「No.
　The $$ウイングガンダムゼロ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_7c9a719cd8f27d1d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Don't get full of yourself, $$シャア$$.」

stage0069_03:r_f6f98a8ef73d1d43.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Let me say this, $$シャア$$.
　No matter how you spin it, I won't approve of your methods.」

stage0069_03:r_160384a0c68215c6.text:
$$シャア$$
「No.
　The $$ウイングガンダムゼロ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_3569c3ca91ae0f9d.text:
$$カレン$$
「It's been a while, Dr. $$トライア$$.」

stage0069_03:r_497aca854c5f874d.text:
$$トライア$$
「Good to see you're both doing well too.」

stage0069_03:r_1797d61f82be363c.text:
$$アルト$$
「Crowe's probably caught up in the $$時空震動$$,
　but how's 《$$エスター$$》 doing?」

stage0069_03:r_f2e19618032127d3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'd be happy if $$エスター$$ could join
　$c too...」

stage0069_03:r_9d5428667d48c806.text:
$$トライア$$
「Sorry.
　They're plenty busy themselves.」

stage0069_03:r_21454fd877c0ae7b.text:
$$トライア$$
「Once that's settled, I'll have them join up with you.」

stage0069_03:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$カレン$$
「It's a promise.
　Please tell $$エスター$$ that too.」

stage0069_03:r_b101d62bbac1b33b.text:
$$トライア$$
「It's nothing.
　Come... let's go watch $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s experiment.」

stage0069_03:r_05b808b1583f5be2.text:
$$シン$$
「What in the world is that man thinking...?」

stage0069_03:r_6bdc8a8243c655ed.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Well, something's definitely off with him, at least.
　No one in their right mind
　would start a war like this.」

stage0069_03:r_72be9250b889c959.text:
$$カトル$$
「Sitting in Wing Zero's cockpit means
　he wants to activate the Zero System, but...」

stage0069_03:r_2cfc9851abe4070e.text:
$$キラ$$
「$$五飛$$... what do you think?」

stage0069_03:r_0831afdf480052ed.text:
$$五飛$$
「... He's probably looking for an answer.」

stage0069_03:r_b402ecf2db57f319.text:
$$トロワ$$
「The future the Zero System leads to...」

stage0069_03:r_adc5793509f8d46c.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I too once saw someone troubled
　find their answer through the Zero System.」

stage0069_03:r_f581e32ff0b84e01.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「But at times, it amplifies the fear and
　doubt within, leading to the worst outcome.」

stage0069_03:r_c5ffa17ba0fae8d3.text:
$$刹那$$
「I don't think there's a need to worry.」

stage0069_03:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ is our enemy.
　But his resolve and conviction never wavered.」

stage0069_03:r_ae527ac0a641a269.text:
$$刹那$$
「That man's grown far stronger than the
　$$クワトロ・バジーナ$$ we knew.」

stage0069_03:r_b76534e2de5b6334.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then, $$ヒイロ$$... let me borrow Zero.」

stage0069_03:r_ee41ea400d1ee0bf.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Only if you can actually handle it.」

stage0069_03:r_90b6cb0493a2982b.text:
$$リディ$$
「Just in case, I've had mobile suit units
　deployed around the perimeter.」

stage0069_03:r_a5181af1cc2bdd02.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Try anything odd, and be ready for the consequences.」

stage0069_03:r_59a1074cc884fdbd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0069_03:r_b66bbe1f07a7674e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't get carried away, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.
　The Colonel only pays you mind to hide his guilt.」

stage0069_03:r_16141de28d738543.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You really do like him, huh.」

stage0069_03:r_1a123affe838b8b1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Fine, I'll correct myself.
　You're conscious of him, then.」

stage0069_03:r_fb72b64c842ba487.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Of course.
　I'm the man who'll surpass the Colonel.」

stage0069_03:r_54e755252ec3acc4.text:
$$クェス$$
「Relieved to see you're doing well too, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_5dcadcd6c77bc7dc.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Are you still planning to keep fighting?」

stage0069_03:r_f22e056851da9461.text:
$$クェス$$
「I don't want to talk about that.」

stage0069_03:r_97923e3dd5dae64b.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Did $$シャア$$ foresee this happening,
　and bring these two as escorts...）

stage0069_03:r_c8b34405ed7bfde7.text:
$$アムロ$$
（If so, he might have grown up
　more than I gave him credit for...）

stage0069_03:r_286cd6be5271ecd2.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then, $$ヒイロ$$... let me borrow Zero.」

stage0069_03:r_93b46e3c24ed4825.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Only if you can actually handle it.」

stage0069_03:r_4b3e91da51d87c72.text:
$$リディ$$
「Just in case, I've had mobile suit units
　deployed around the perimeter.」

stage0069_03:r_912c58272c320559.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Try anything odd, and we'll hold you responsible.」

stage0069_03:r_7fd3cd80460fefb1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0069_03:r_b99c671eb373edd1.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't get carried away, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.
　The Colonel only pays you mind to hide his guilt.」

stage0069_03:r_c8e48adccc9bbba8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You really do like him, huh.」

stage0069_03:r_ed6e99341ad5bf40.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Fine, I'll correct myself.
　You're conscious of him, then.」

stage0069_03:r_a671f14759794503.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Of course.
　I'm the man who'll surpass the Colonel.」

stage0069_03:r_121b55dcb47984aa.text:
$$クェス$$
「Relieved to see you're doing well too, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_0c472072ac8bda60.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Are you still planning to keep fighting?」

stage0069_03:r_a378a46f62b5980d.text:
$$クェス$$
「I don't want to talk about that.」

stage0069_03:r_f0ce8e3e0d75533e.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Did $$シャア$$ foresee this happening,
　and bring these two as escorts...）

stage0069_03:r_87e728176c45393f.text:
$$アムロ$$
（If so, he might have grown up
　more than I gave him credit for...）

stage0069_03:r_8e2f92d078970a2b.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Then, Lady $$ハマーン・カーン$$...
　I'll now complete the procedures
　to hand over Lieutenant $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

stage0069_03:r_5c0f74cc35812a77.text:
$$レイアム$$
「... This oversteps my military duties,
　but allow me to say one thing.」

stage0069_03:r_0bb68446ec330a05.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The scars all over her body...
　They look like they're not from combat or training.」

stage0069_03:r_8e1ebf6b0c149f4b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Blaming me for that would be misplaced.」

stage0069_03:r_86f0e9b721a4f655.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$マリーダ$$'s scars and harsh past
　exist because Zeon lost the war to the Federation.」

stage0069_03:r_c42f7ca81fe0cf88.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「A girl with no registry, from a defeated nation,
　you can imagine what fate she'd meet.
　Her scars are from that time.」

stage0069_03:r_836fc0eae35929e9.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't worry about it.
　That's what war is.」

stage0069_03:r_aed2fc42c9a9ecdd.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「One misstep, and that fate
　could have been yours as well.」

stage0069_03:r_271fbb35b579a866.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'd like to speak with her alone.
　Could you step out for a bit?」

stage0069_03:r_b40fe3d3e6f2b1d9.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Understood.
　But I will be posting a watch.」

stage0069_03:r_778c6eb2f5afc622.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「... Sorry, $$マリーダ$$.
　For telling that officer about your past.」

stage0069_03:r_3fb74a41e682c7de.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「No... I was happy that you got angry
　as if it were your own affair, Your Excellency.」

stage0069_03:r_47c1edbfd5664fd7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm a woman too.
　As was that officer earlier.」

stage0069_03:r_fbdb8764f80a1b12.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's why she tried to raise
　a protest with me beyond her duty.」

stage0069_03:r_d1b8cb87f8ea00d6.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「... Just fellow human beings, is that it...」

stage0069_03:r_bba76accfb31e66d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「You've changed a little, $$マリーダ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_6095c82e60cdd7af.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「No need to apologize.
　You're human before you're a soldier too.」

stage0069_03:r_df79b5dc7ceda4c0.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「... Have you made contact with her?」

stage0069_03:r_48a06834bb510d7d.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I haven't seen her face.
　Even now, she seems to be avoiding this place.」

stage0069_03:r_f19a063712278769.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「So she doesn't want to see us...
　At least her identity hasn't been revealed yet.」

stage0069_03:r_48fd2b5d0978ba1c.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「She seems to be trying to learn something here.」

stage0069_03:r_90591ae4aa6d92d6.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「So it seems.
　She spent her girlhood in a dark asteroid belt.
　Everything she sees must be new to her.」

stage0069_03:r_3c39aed29379134c.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「What do you intend to do, Your Excellency?」

stage0069_03:r_bff5468c57365d6b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I think about it sometimes...
　Since she has no place in Neo Zeon as it stands,
　whether this is fine as is...」

stage0069_03:r_9520c4f160aa3ebd.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I thought you were pro-Zabi, Your Excellency.」

stage0069_03:r_9dc3c6963e7dac77.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「We are not Zeon.
　We are Neo Zeon.」

stage0069_03:r_173107393504e4d1.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（$$シャア$$...
　What are you seeing now...）

stage0069_03:r_5933be40e8f9d954.text:
$$シャア$$
（Space...
　Is this a vision the Zero System is showing me...）

stage0069_03:r_0d848a222f69347d.text:
$$シャア$$
（Or is this the nightmare of a man crushed by the future...）

stage0069_03:r_d8483ee925825d04.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ララァ$$'s soul still exists in this universe, even now...!」

stage0069_03:r_dae622560a4cfc83.text:
$$ララァ$$
「$$アムロ$$ once said...
　that people could someday control even time...」

stage0069_03:r_aa09da82b4c52a2a.text:
$$シャア$$
「I see...!
　So that's how it was...」

stage0069_03:r_d0acd2176373fca3.text:
$$ララァ$$
「But I believe...
　that shaking off the past is also a human strength...」

stage0069_03:r_dda2f4922920a4e0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So you were able to come back.」

stage0069_03:r_683f2ca0d6804be4.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Your mind doesn't seem to have snapped.
　I'll give you that much.」

stage0069_03:r_4267b07b216d5d90.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（What did he see with the Zero System...）

stage0069_03:r_c4554163734c62f1.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, hurry and launch!
　The $$インベーダー#keyword$$s are coming to this area!」

stage0069_03:r_890ab04baf542979.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Proof the dimensional boundary's not fixed!
　Don't wanna see your face, but glad you came!」

stage0069_03:r_3cf33f3773748d0f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...That's the situation.
　I'll be in your care for a while.」

stage0069_03:r_533e554662b8c631.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「For now, we're fighting for the same goal.
　You're welcome here.」

stage0069_03:r_b06b2a23a76e8ce4.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.
　I don't intend to get chummy.」

stage0069_03:r_26db4dd6c24f9835.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's fine, $$カツ$$.
　I'd be nervous too, in his position.」

stage0069_03:r_d224d5baf3493ab2.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm not the least bit nervous.」

stage0069_03:r_3ee3743094a4a145.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Understood.
　Good to have you, $$ギュネイ$$.」

stage0069_03:r_180eb1536d754e3c.text:
$$シン$$
「...As always,
　$$カミーユ$$'s good at handling guys like that.」

stage0069_03:r_015674a403ccf13a.text:
$$ファ$$
「Before joining the $$エゥーゴ$$,
　$$カミーユ$$ himself was just like that, though.」

stage0069_03:r_ef91c7636fe8aad4.text:
$$シン$$
「Huh... so that's how it was.」

stage0069_03:r_397bc0c659cbf227.text:
$$キラ$$
「I bet he'll turn out like $$シン$$ too.」

stage0069_03:r_f2effcece0132e9d.text:
$$シン$$
「What's that supposed to mean, $$キラ$$?!」

stage0069_03:r_f7c5d0246e396cd5.text:
$$キラ$$
「I wonder what it could mean.」

stage0069_03:r_7aa9edfa8692bb8d.text:
$$クェス$$
「Looks like you haven't changed either, $$シン$$.」

stage0069_03:r_4fec64c622a0514b.text:
$$クェス$$
「Well, I am who I am.」

stage0069_03:r_20d5fb63b23b2310.text:
$$チェーン$$
「I'll be the one handling maintenance
　checks on your mobile suit.
　Nice to meet you, $$クェス$$.」

stage0069_03:r_6bfb2bfe97891db7.text:
$$クェス$$
「Fine, I get it, $$ハサウェイ$$...
　...nice to meet you, $$チェーン$$.」

stage0069_03:r_3a4a5d03e079f53d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Seems like you're worried about $$シャア$$.」

stage0069_03:r_037dafa5c5124420.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「What's your take on it, Captain?」

stage0069_03:r_87d57a77ad22ca35.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But because of that, there's a danger
　he'll try to shoulder everything alone.」

stage0069_03:r_e44c30f3b562be6c.text:
$$五飛$$
「So he's walking the same path as $$トレーズ$$?」

stage0069_03:r_4711ef8ef992a14e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's exactly why, before he does something
　irreversible, someone needs to stop him.」

stage0069_03:r_58564bddc1ac08b5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not that I'm putting myself forward.
　He's the one who picked me.」

stage0069_03:r_6a06cc16f6683240.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「First, keep your pact with him.」

stage0069_03:r_e2efb08e47011ced.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A search for a Singularity on Earth, huh...」

stage0069_03:r_d1f368432258ec05.text:
$$アムロ$$
（But there's one thing that bothers me...）

stage0069_03:r_6330bf8e56b514cf.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Why did $$シャア$$ use the Zero System...
　What was he looking for in it...）

stage0069_03:r_83d6f0d49d974865.text:
$$シャア$$
「...That covers how the talks went.」

stage0069_03:r_36ba6439169b2472.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A search for a Singularity...
　Why tell me of such an important operation?」

stage0069_03:r_d19e2d3230e09c6a.text:
$$シャア$$
「No need for modesty.
　You're capable enough for it.」

stage0069_03:r_857468de19815523.text:
$$シャア$$
「Just out of curiosity, let me ask.
　Would you choose a slow death, or ruin?」

stage0069_03:r_72f66f82d72a5e2c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$, or $$バアル$$'s onslaught...
　I'd pick the former.」

stage0069_03:r_ac913a939029996b.text:
$$シャア$$
「A gentle suicide, born of stagnation...」

stage0069_03:r_02497c17fe7cb67c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I don't see it that way.
　I'd call that stability.」

stage0069_03:r_8455446770647f64.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「In short, if people can go on living
　with reason in a world where time has stopped,
　that would truly be eternity.」

stage0069_03:r_4f6b361fd2c92e92.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I don't care for that phrasing...
　It sounds so grown-up.」

stage0069_03:r_d9f2b8012ba37fc5.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I apologize for my rudeness.」

stage0069_03:r_cdf86c7be0122aaf.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I've asked this before...
　Who are you?」

stage0069_03:r_62cbe4ab456fe01c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If I may say so with some pride,
　I believe the Red Comet's name is mine to inherit.」

stage0069_03:r_de0d7af4922e4e7a.text:
$$シャア$$
「What meaning do you find in that name?」

stage0069_03:r_bc321459e2182228.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「One who guides this world to its rightful form...
　Am I mistaken?」

stage0069_03:r_92a92fbd8a2b734e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I'll get back to fighting the Federation's main force.」

stage0069_03:r_9183713553991f3e.text:
$$シャア$$
「Cover the hole $$ギュネイ$$ and $$クェス$$ left behind.」

stage0069_03:r_a65f2c6073076762.text:
$$シャア$$
（$$フル・フロンタル$$...
　Why do you know $$ララァ$$'s words...）

stage0069_03:r_bd55bb9029e467d1.text:
$$キング$$
「...You may raise your head, $$サイガス・エイロニー$$.」

stage0069_03:r_891efb3059812af8.text:
$$キング$$
「The Chrono Council of Thirteen approved your entry.」

stage0069_03:r_3baa2769c86302e6.text:
$$キング$$
「As of today, you too are one of Chrono.」

stage0069_03:r_18c345e4b68c12c7.text:
$$キング$$
「Follow the doctrine we'll relay to you,
　and act as a watcher over humanity's evolution.」

stage0069_03:r_91b7a61294c05a90.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Th-thank you, I'm overjoyed!
　For one who failed to capture $$バアル$$'s decisive weapon,
　this honor is more than I deserve!」

stage0069_03:r_265114998c9cdda8.text:
$$サイガス$$
「I'll carry out my duties, staking my very life!」

stage0069_03:r_d99f05052bd03651.text:
$$キング$$
「But for now, your membership is only provisional.
　For you to be formally recognized as a member...」

stage0069_03:r_ec02d70600f29cb1.text:
$$サイガス$$
「I understand.
　I'll surely make those Spacenoids fall silent.」

stage0069_03:r_9071778073533579.text:
$$キング$$
「I expect the best from you.
　Now, withdraw.」

stage0069_03:r_c5d14cea3feb3258.text:
$$クィーン$$
「Are you sure?
　Approving the membership of one like that...」

stage0069_03:r_94c58684d3d2f2cc.text:
$$クィーン$$
「Extreme action only invites needless failure.
　So it was with $$ティターンズ$$, so with $$ブルーコスモス$$...」

stage0069_03:r_90c004166d6998d3.text:
$$クィーン$$
「And in turn, it could become fertile ground
　for producing someone like $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada.」

stage0069_03:r_d1593dddba79767f.text:
$$クィーン$$
「And now... even $$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0069_03:r_b559a709c05c466e.text:
$$キング$$
「No need to worry.
　We need only stay true to our doctrine.
　However forceful, results come first.」

stage0069_03:r_d940e68fde96e892.text:
$$キング$$
「Even taking in a philistine like that
　was merely a stopgap measure」

stage0069_03:r_d4539352ead4c516.text:
$$キング$$
「Besides, to fill the seats left empty by
　Aeolia Schoenberg and $$エルガン・ローディック$$,
　some replenishment can't be helped」

stage0069_03:r_3a86021bb5195379.text:
Member A
「I can't believe they... didn't just leave the group,
　but split Chrono in two from the inside...」

stage0069_03:r_028e78edf8b38c6c.text:
Member B
「Those damned apostates, self-styled reformists...
　Even knowing retribution awaits them eventually...」

stage0069_03:r_cd169febb82df2fb.text:
Member A
「The action squad has made contact
　with $c several times」

stage0069_03:r_69ec96fb8da7c25c.text:
Member B
「Also, they pulled strings with Anaheim
　to send $c a unit made for the Awakened」

stage0069_03:r_9a22aa8d49b88417.text:
$$キング$$
「Fools exist in every era, it seems...」

stage0069_03:r_112c133deaee5282.text:
$$クィーン$$
「Perhaps it's because the time is near...」

stage0069_03:r_ce4876c69922ab65.text:
$$キング$$
「Let's set them aside for now.
　What we must do first is uphold doctrine」

stage0069_03:r_e1a3d4cb622d1379.text:
$$クィーン$$
「...I hear $$シャア・アズナブル$$ has
　made contact with $c」

stage0069_03:r_f9c80ffd03c02dbb.text:
Member A
「What will you do?
　Best to nip a dangerous sprout early, I'd think...」

stage0069_03:r_947f475c9b344398.text:
$$キング$$
「In the end, they're like birds in a cage.
　However they struggle, they're only powerless」

stage0069_03:r_11d00beba857914c.text:
Member B
「Then, as always, we'll follow the proxy's orders...」

stage0069_03:r_b4b6f78fa1c50d56.text:
$$キング$$
「We are Chrono.
　As the watchers over humanity's evolution,
　we must fulfill that duty until the very end」

stage0069_03:r_6cf284b1a823ba2b.text:
$$キング$$
「Only fulfilling it grants the mercy of eternity」

stage0069_03:r_b41738c2c296ec08.text:
Member B
「Those reformists who forget that will be judged」

stage0069_03:r_2809477b354952d7.text:
$$クィーン$$
「Perhaps I should call it divine punishment...」

stage0069_03:r_70e2d7c09c997d80.text:
$$キング$$
「Either way, that time draws near」

stage0069_03:r_33ca14bc62a8ea9e.text:
$$キング$$
「Yes... that day is the dawn of a new era」

stage0069_03:r_731c9dd791416eab.text:
$n
「What about the data I asked for?」

stage0069_03:r_6d64b6e7f8b0364d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Got it covered!
　It includes the combat data on $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　and $$ハマーン・カーン$$ from today's battle too!」

stage0069_03:r_19afcbf950a9cea2.text:
$n
「Watching up close, those two are on a different level」

stage0069_03:r_b3edb5df8a517f28.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, I suppose so.
